what: Every role, in a pane or headless, gets Pi's codemode tool next to its listed tools, added by pi-role; codemode reaches only the role's listed tools, so read-only roles stay without edit or write; roles run Pi's defaults codemode.mode on and codemode.inlineBudget 3000, set by no kit file. The director's tool list now includes codemode. Adds acceptance-codemode-every-role.
why: Owner ruling (2026-10-23, issue #106): all octo-feather agents use Pi codemode, so a script can run tool calls in parallel and filter large results before they reach context; it must not widen any role's tool allowlist.
evidence: roles#fm-tools ('Strict allowlist of built-in Pi tools') and roles#acceptance-director-tools ('the director's tools are read, grep, find, ls and bash') against issue #106 ('every role ... gets codemode alongside its listed tools'); scripts/pi-role passes --tools <list>, which replaces Pi's selection, so no role has codemode (Pi docs cli.md #tools). Probe 2026-10-25: pi --tools read,grep,find,ls,bash,codemode --no-mcp: ALL_TOOLS in a codemode script is read,bash,grep,find,ls.

what: Roles whose tools list web (director, implementer, corrector, code reviewer) get web search and page fetch as tools: every tool of the keyless hosted MCP servers in the kit's one web server list (Parallel, Exa); no other MCP server reaches any role, and a role without web runs with no MCP. why: Owner ruling (2026-10-27, issue #256 and its two comments): agents get web search, fetch and a real browser to find maintained libraries and read docs before building; core capabilities are tools or a CLI with a skill, domain capabilities a CLI plus a skill, MCP only delivers core tools (recorded in ADR 0016, corrected in place).
evidence: roles#boundary-pi-role ('no MCP') and roles#acceptance-director-tools ('the director's tools are read, grep, find, ls, bash and codemode') against issue #256 ('implementer, corrector, code reviewer, director get search/fetch'); scripts/pi-role:124 passes --no-mcp to every role. Probe 2026-10-28: PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR with only search.parallel.ai/mcp and mcp.exa.ai/mcp, `pi mcp list`: both connected with no key (web_search, web_fetch; web_search_exa, web_fetch_exa).
